text: Dimka is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier of Fireteam Taurus in the United Nations Space Command.
A catstaff was a magical weapon and item that granted thief-like abilities.
Denning is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. They attended the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
Dovanir is a Jiralhanae Chieftain in service of the Banished.
Ernst Deming was a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier who served as the team leader of Fireteam Castle on the .
Celestial Fury was a powerful magical katana from Shou Lung in Kara-Tur. It carried the spirit of a celestial and powers of thunder and lightning.
Eusebio is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. He attended the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
Hieu Dinh is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier serving under Commander Laurette Agryna.
Hong is a Spartan-IV supersoldier stationed aboard and a member of Fireteam Bailey.
Cefrey was a spellcaster and looter who was active on the Sword Coast region during the late 15 century DR. For a time, she worked under the employ of Gimblebock.

Kel 'Darsam was a beloved demigod warrior-hero from ancient Sangheili mythology. He is the central character in the Ballad of Kel 'Darsam, a famous narrative poem widely known and sung to Sangheili children.

Spartan Commander Laurette Agryna is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier, notable for having served as the commanding officer for the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science on the hidden outpost world of Nysa. As Spartan Commander for the academy. she oversaw the facility's day-to-day operations alongside the tasking and training of its Spartan personnel. In March 2560, the academy was attacked and occupied by the Banished, resulting in Agryna's exile to Anvil Station alongside the other survivors of the attack. Agryna was born the daughter of an Spartan-I supersoldier Holden Agryna, though there is no indication she is one of the "Spartan 1.1s", who were seemingly-given biological augmentation as children.
Leung is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. They attended the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
Chalik Proudfist was a member of the Proudfist tribe of half-orcs who dwelled on the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR.

Mara was the "lending name" of a female ape who lived on Installation 07 during the later years of the Forerunner-Flood war. She was the last living member of the largest species of ape to have ever existed, classified today as Gigantopithecus and known as Shakyanusho in ancient times. Resembling a gorilla in general shape, Mara was enormous in size, reaching around three meters in height when standing upright. Despite her size, she was noted to move quietly and with remarkable grace and agility. She had a wide face with sunken, green eyes, and most of her body was covered in black and dark reddish fur.
Ironclads are a type of Mgalekgolo employed by the Ironclad pack, a subordinate unit within the Banished.
Nina Kovan, nicknamed The Stoic, is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier of Fireteam Shadow in the United Nations Space Command, operating under the callsign Shadow Four.
Cecil Proudfoot was a halfling who lived on the Sword Coast North during the late 15 century DR.
Nora-098 was a Spartan-II supersoldier in the United Nations Space Command. She was killed in action on Mamore.
Oshiro is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier of Fireteam Taurus in the United Nations Space Command.

A Preceptor was a Forerunner who had refined and specialized their body and mind to become a living paragon of scientific, artistic, or martial skill. Preceptors were categorized as tier-two Peacemakers, powerful constructs used to enforce the Forerunners' vision of the Mantle of Responsibility on the galaxy. Along with Guardian Custodes, Preceptors were charged with monitoring and fencing off the activity of lesser species within pocket empires. When a developing civilisation was encountered, they may be employed to guide that civilisation's development in line with the preferences of the Ecumene. The Prefects, an organisation within the Warrior-Servants, reported exclusively to a council of Preceptors. The Prefects' observational reports on Forerunner colonies and subject worlds were used by the Preceptors to make decisions regarding the allocation of the Ecumene's resources, be it the deployment of Lifeworker teams or Peacemakers.

The Caverns of Karrundax were a series of caves, tunnels and chasms that wound through the volcanic peak of Mount Hotenow on the Sword Coast North. They were named for the fact that the red dragon Karrundax chose its depths within which to make its lair.
Colonel Randall Aiken, formerly Randall-037, was a commissioned officer of the Colonial Guard on the Outer Colony planet of Sedra and a former SPARTAN-II supersoldier.

Rudolf Schein was a human soldier who became a Spartan-IV supersoldier and defected to the United Rebel Front after the Human-Covenant War. His attempt to kill the second class of the SPARTAN-IV program led to his death.
Sara S. is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. Their service number is 91226-81014-SS. They graduated from the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
A cestus () was a type of offensive gauntlet found in the Realms, primarily known for being used by gladiators.
Sarkar was a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier in the United Nations Space Command.

Salient-Lance was a Forerunner Warrior-Servant serving the Ecumene during the empire's height. Salient-Lance was involved in an unspecified conflict during his life, and wielded the Scatterbound Heatwave during a boarding action against an unidentified warship. At the time of the engagement, Salient-Lance served aboard a Forerunner Dragoon, and was paired with an ancilla inside his combat skin.

Tashi was a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier who served with Fireteam Castle on the . In February 2558, Tashi and the rest of Fireteam Castle were killed after their Pelican was shot down by Jul 'Mdama's forces while on a supply run to Copernicus Base.
The Chalice of Amaunator was a powerful and ancient Amaunatori artifact. It was considered a powerful weapon against the forces of darkness and the antithesis of anything related to the Shadow Weave.

"The Executor" is an unidentified formerly-human individual serving under High Auxiliary Sloan in the Created. They are the first of the Executors - cybernetically augmented supersoldiers created by Sloan to serve as the bridge for artificial intelligences to interface with the physical world. The Executor was originally notable as the first known human to uncover the existence of The Assembly, a clandestine group of AI working to guide humanity over the course of centuries. They were driven into madness by their discovery, and eventually used by the Created to become the Executor.
Todd A. is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. Their service number is 51420-19230-TA. They graduated from the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
This unidentified operator was a Spartan-IV supersoldier in the United Nations Space Command's Spartan Operations branch.
Cerelias was a Netherese fighter who worked as a guide in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in . He was one of those locals who gave guided tours to visitors.

Bionatops as it appear in Masters of the Universe: Revelation. The mythical dinosaurs known as the Bionatops was used by King Grayskull as his steed during the Hunt in the Eternian afterlife, also known as Preternia.

Chadaz is one of the three Giants featured in the 200x cartoon episode Buzz-Off's Pride, voiced by Mark Acheson. He has red skin and a single short golden earring in his left ear. The three giants are known for steeling the Village of Veridas' Crystal of Prasinus. While Chadaz does not seem to be the leader of the giants he is the one who came with the alternative plan to keep people from crossing the bridge. Also known for being part of Skeletor's Council of Evil.

AGiraphant is an animal in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. A cross between a giraffe and a elephant, this giant pachyderm resided near the Oasis on Primus. The shepherd Drissi once found a Giraphant stuck between a couple of trees. Luckily her brother Caz was wearing a Medi-Suit at the time to nurse an injured leg, which also gave him extraordinary strength. Caz managed to break the Giraphant free from the trees.
Chalak was a human fighter serving in his tribe's army in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Mutated Ram Man Mutated Battering Ram!, is a mutated character in the Turtles of Grayskull action figure line and mini-comics.
Mutated Ram Man Mutated Battering Ram!, is a mutated character in the Turtles of Grayskull action figure line and mini-comics.

A Rock Lizard is a creature in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. The Rock Lizard was a giant creature native to the Dark Side of the moon Nordor. It's back was covered by rocks, making it easy for the creature to camouflage itself in it's native terrain. When He-Man, Artilla and Gepple were on a mission to destroy the Guns of Nordor, they had to travel the cliffs of Nordor by foot. They accidentally disturbed a Rock Lizard during it's slumber and had to fight it off. He-Man used a backflip to frighten the giant creature off.
Celestia, Brightest Star of Day was a great sun blade bastard sword that emerged in the late 15 century DR.

The Silaxians are a race from the planet Silax with a highly renowned hunters, trappers, and warriors who are dedicated to fighting evil, and Huntara is one of their best. The Silaxians are the greatest warriors and bounty hunters in the universe, according to Hordak. They're not members of the Evil Horde and know little about it, but are willing to work for them. When battling an opponent, a Silaxian will invariably insist on not receiving help, and prefers one-on-one combats. By the code of Silax, if a Silaxian warrior is defeated by an opponent, the Silaxian is to become the opponent's slave.
A Winged Horse is a creature from the 1983 animated series He-Man and the Masters of the Universe.

is a , and the Master of Synapse's latest mass-produced Angeloid. They appear as black versions of Ikaros, Nymph, and Astraea. There were multiple Ikaros Melan in contrast to the single copies of Nymph and Astraea. Soon, the copies were sent by their creator to kill Tomoki.
Ceremonial plate was a unique set of enchanted armor that belonged to Turiel, a scourge aasimar of Bahamut, during his adventuring days in the late 15 century DR.
The Alpha Commander is a heavily-armored and supercharged variant of the Brood Commander.
, referred to in chapter titles as is the Stand of Mitsuba Higashikata, featured in JoJolion.

is the Stand of Noriaki Kakyoin, featured in Stardust Crusaders. Hierophant Green is an elastic and remote Stand, capable of being deployed far away from its user and performing actions from a distance. Kakyoin has possessed this Stand since birth.

, a chaotic evil fighter.]] The chaotic evil alignment was power without control, selfishness unrestrained by law and order. Chaotic evil characters acted according to whatever their greed, hatred, and lust for destruction drove them to do. Whether out for themselves, or dedicated to a cause that spread evil and chaos, they were ruthless and brutal in their execution. Typically, they could only be made to align and work with others through force or coercion, with leaders lasting only as long as they could thwart attempts at being overthrown or assassinated. Ultimately, these characters will commit any act to further their own ends. Many serial killers would fit this description, as would indeed most of the more violent and reckless criminals found in the worst sorts of places. ;Opposing alignment: Chaotic evil characters were free from any sense of order or morality. Lawful good characters sought to do benevolent deeds for others within the confines of the laws of civilized society. These two alignments were in opposition to one another.

The is the main antagonist of the short story "Bloodsoaked Bookmark", part of the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: Short Story Collection. Appearing as a female librarian secretly lurking at S City's library, the Incarnation of Curiosity is a seemingly immortal being who lures in people capable of answering questions she has.

is a primary antagonist featured in the light novel El Aleph. He is a gang leader of human smugglers who shoots hundreds of civilians with the Bow and Arrow, hoping to awaken their powers. He is also a Stand user, wielding El Corazón de las Tinieblas.

is a secondary ally featured in the light novel El Aleph. As a young teen, he is a hostage of Fernando Arjón who awakens the Stand Yawar Fiesta from the Bow and Arrow. After being rescued by Sasha Loggins, Octavio Luna Kan, and Joaquín Ruiz-Jorruda, he goes to live on a floating island on .

Charon's Claw, also known simply as Claw, was a minor artifact comprising an enchanted sword and accompanying gauntlet. It was designed to battle wizards and was once wielded by the highly skilled assassin Artemis Entreri.

is a tertiary antagonist featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is an incarnation of the original Prosciutto, living in the 37th universe. Prosciutto Cappano wields the Stand Twister and is a member of Passione who invades Morioh and attacks random civilians. He and his Stand are not actually directly mentioned in the novel by name, but they are drawn in the illustrations and named in the captions.

is a supporting character in the 37th universe, featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. Initially a tertiary antagonist, he later becomes an ally in the final battle. The Funniest is a Stand user who wields Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap, with the powerful ability to travel across parallel universes. He is the son of Funnier Valentine and the grandson of Funny Valentine from the 37th universe.

The unnamed , also known as the , is a posthumous tertiary antagonist featured in the second part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency. As the last remaining zombie created by Dio to survive the events of Phantom Blood, he disguised himself for decades as a commander in the British RAF until his true nature was discovered by George Joestar II. He murdered George, who was subsequently avenged by his wife Elizabeth in a fit of rage. He is also a secondary antagonist in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR, named William Cardinal.
Chaos hammer was a divine evocation spell exclusive to clerics with the Chaos domain. It harmed only lawful enemies.

is the Stand of an unknown user working for Fernando Arjón, featured in the light novel El Aleph. It acts as an automatic security system, tilting walls and having sharp spines to throw off intruders who touch the walls of a building. Joaquín Ruiz-Jorruda names it based on the noise it makes.
The is a revered immortal invited up to Heaven for a banquet.
Agaard Jum Sai is the Muay Boran Master and Sovereign Fist of Yami's One Shadow, Nine Fists and the master of Tirawit Kōkin.

Chitin armor () was made from the shells of chitinous creatures such as ankheg, giant crabs, or remorhaz. It was flexible and could be comfortable, and was known to be used by aquatic elves and some savage cultures. The armor was valued around 75 gp and weighed 20 lb (10 kg).

*Name: Fuurinji Hito Shuuriken (Furinji Human Shuriken) *Martial Art Style: Furinji Style *User: Hayato Furinji, Saiga Furinji The user grabs their opponents and literally throws thems as if they were real shuriken. He picked the technique up from the Kuremisago Clan.
Armored Xehanort is Master Xehanort after merging with the Replica Xehanorts; wielding new powers and a new Keyblade Armor. He is the penultimate boss of Kingdom Hearts III.

Dark Baymax serves as a boss in Kingdom Hearts III and is the original Baymax designed by Tadashi Hamada. He was lost in a void sometime prior to Sora coming to San Fransokyo. Dark Baymax is the result of Dark Riku and the Darkubes imbuing negative feelings into him and ultimately corrupting his combat chip.
Charsultketh, also known as Helanna Darkstorm, was the newest member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR.
The Dark Inferno is a Pureblood Heartless that appears as a Boss in Kingdom Hearts III. A weaker version, deemed Dark Inferno X, fought Sora upon entering Ventus' Heart, stating he was "too pure".

The is a Pureblood Heartless that is found in Kingdom Hearts II and Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix. The Gargoyle Warrior is very similar to the Gargoyle Knight. It has spiky armor all over its body. It attacks by spinning around with its axe. They blend in with real statues in Beast's Castle, and then ambush Sora and friends when they come near.

Lauriam was a Keyblade wielder who appears in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. He is a member of the Dandelions and has been chosen by the Master of Masters to lead a Union after the Keyblade War. He is the older brother of Strelitzia, and the human form of Marluxia.

A chatkcha () was a type of exotic throwing weapon invented by the thri-kreen and unique to them. The chatkcha was a kind of triangular throwing wedge with three piercing points. The thri-kreen carved it from a crystalline material. It could deal critical injuries to a target, and was effective to 20 feet (6 meters) and could be thrown up to 270 feet (82 meters). A thrown wedge that missed its target could even return to the thrower. A warrior needed to be highly trained to use one, as it would cut an unprotected hand, but it was much more familiar to the thri-kreen. Collectors would pay for one in good condition.
The Earth Gargoyle is a Pureblood Heartless that was introduced in Kingdom Hearts Dark Road.

James P. Sullivan, also known as Sulley, is a CEO and former top-scarer introduced in Kingdom Hearts III, and originally taken from the Disney/Pixar film He is in charge of the Monsters, Inc. energy corporation that supplies power to Monstropolis, assisted by his old friend Mike Wazowski, but comes into conflict with his former coworker, Randall Boggs.
Jack-Jack is a character in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. He is a baby with a plethora of superpowers.
Cheslaera Fallowfern was the leader of the Flaming Sword Riders, an adventuring company that operated in Luruar and the North during the 1370s DR.
The Metal Giant is an Emblem Heartless that was introduced in Kingdom Hearts Union χ during the Boys' Day cross campaign in 2017.
Caucasusman is a choushin and the physical incarnation of the God of Discipline.

is the sixth boss in . He is the Shrine Keeper of the Shrine of Strength. Ursore is a bear who values strength above all else and values himself as a strong warrior. His servants are the Shrine's three Knights, and he becomes angry when Zelda manages to overcome them in battle.
Chariots were a type of two-wheeled, animal-drawn land vehicle. They were typically pulled by horses and they provided warriors better protection and maneuverability on battlefields.
Tris are servants of the Golden Goddesses: Din, Nayru, and Farore. They were created to heal rifts created by Null, so that the world doesn't become consumed by darkness and void.
Aboshan was the ruler of the cephalid Mer Empire that controlled a large portion of Dominaria's oceans after the Phyrexian Invasion.
Abian is a monstrous non-humanoid planeswalker with control over spirits who has usurped the plane of Luvion.

Charleston Nib was an archaeologist who lived on the Sword Coast, for at least a short time, during the mid–14 century DR. He believed in scholarly pursuits and believed his findings were best suited for display in Faerûnian museums.
Akim, the Soaring Wind is a legendary flying dinosaur from the plane of Ikoria.
Aggressor is a giant cat from Kaldheim, and a guardian of the Gods' Hall of Starnheim.
Altair of Coloni, also known as the "White Mage" was a planeswalker of white magic from the Plains of Coloni on Corondor on Dominaria.
Chin Yi was a trumpet archon in service to Kwan Ying, goddess of compassion of Kara-Tur. Chin Yi's spirit was bound within the katana called Celestial Fury.

Ali Baba was a cunning rogue from Rabiah Ali Baba, a master of unlocking secrets and breaching defenses that others deemed impenetrable. With a simple utterance of "Open, Sesame!", he could cause the most formidable barriers to yield, revealing the hidden treasures and mysteries beyond.
Ao is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. He is the reincarnation of Yosei.

Bartel Runeaxe was a legendary Giant warrior from the mountain stronghold of Hammerheim on Dominaria. He was so named for his trademark weapon — a vicious axe — which was only one aspect of his great strength and endurance. Given that Bartel's lifetime is unknown, and Legendary creatures from the Legends set are from many points in time, he may be long deceased, currently alive, or even yet to be born.

Cherrybread, also known as the Vilholn Cherrybread on the Sword Coast, was a sweet molasses bread with diced and alcohol-soaked cherries, popular in the Vilhon Reach, Border Kingdoms, and the region of the Sea of Fallen Stars, with it's popularity reaching the Sword Coast in the late 15 century DR.
Ashaya is an Elemental that Nissa Revane summoned on Zendikar in her fight against the Eldrazi. It is a fragment of Zendikar's worldsoul.
Beledros Witherbloom is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven. The Witherbloom College is named in her honor. She is a master of the forces of life and death.

Ojer Axonil (oh-HAIR ash-oh-NEEL) is a God from the Core of the plane of Ixalan. As one of the Deep Gods of the Core, he is believed to be a child of Chimil. Ojer Axonil is said to have torn Aclazotz's eye out, and is the one to have imprisoned the bat god.
Choking powder was a substance used as an incapacitating thrown weapon.
Lady Beluna Grandsquall is a Giant noble woman from Stormkeld, Eldraine.
Atemsis, All-Seeing is a legendary Sphinx from an unknown plane introduced in Core Set 2020.
Doc Aurlock is a grizzled bearfolk druid who arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths.
Chase was a rich and overly-dramatic young noble who lived somewhere along the Sword Coast circa 1368 DR.

Borborygmos is an enormous cyclops from Ravnica. He is the largest and angriest of the many large and angry leaders of the Gruul Clans. Although there is little official about the guild, he is often considered to be its Guildmaster. This is because when he gives orders, the Gruul clans listen.

Bilagru is a twelve-foot-tall giant Orzhov executioner and chief enforcer serving to collect debts to kingpin Ilona and the church militant. He wears a suit of gold-filigreed plate armor, and his face is obscured behind a helm with an unmistakably Orzhov-styled cyclopean visor. He wields a two-bladed axe. He is the named threat in the phrase "Bilagru will come for you." Within the guild, Bilagru is an ally of Kaya and Tomik Vrona, who call him "Bil".
C'tan is a creature subtype introduced for the crossover Warhammer 40,000 Commander Decks. It is used to represent sentient beings composed of energy that acted as gods for the Necrons.
Cold Heart was the favored weapon of Kiaransalee, the drow goddess of undeath.
Baron Bertram Graywater is a vampire noble from an unknown plane.

Colfenor was one of the most ancient and wisest treefolk sages on the plane of Lorwyn. He was the only and last living red yew treefolk. The yew treefolk were powerful shamans, and their poison magic, one of the strongest types of magic overall, was unequalled on Lorwyn.
Dew, also known as the Cloudhoof Kirin, is one of the five legendary kirin kami from Kamigawa that are known to meet with each other every 1,000 years.
A cog was a small, one masted sailing ship used on the Sea of Fallen Stars. Another ship, also called a cog, had two masts and was a larger version of the coaster.
Damon was a wizard who lived during the early part of the Thaw of Terisiare, on the plane of Dominaria.

Draco was a powerful artifact dragon that appeared on Dominaria during the first Phyrexian invasion. It is not known what Draco is or originally was, but the artwork suggests that it might have been a natural dragon (instead of a pure artificial construct) that was later modified by the Phyrexians with certain metallic parts,. Despite this, it is not itself defined as a Phyrexian creature, and neither is Scion of Draco.
Pierakor az Vinrenn D'rav, better known as Feather, is a Boros Firemane angel, who spent much time as Agrus Kos's partner.

The Company of the Talking Shield was an adventuring company that operated in the Vast in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Though they were adventurers of some note, they disappeared while exploring the Brynwood some time before 1370 DR.
Florian Voldaren is a vampire noble from Innistrad. He is of the Voldaren bloodline.
Gustha Ebbasdotter was the royal mage of Kjeldor at the time of the Ice Age of Dominaria.
Grakmaw was a massive hydra horror that lurked for centuries in the shadows of a fallen Skyclave on Jwar Isle in Ondu, Zendikar.
The Company of the Bright Spear was an adventuring company in the Dalelands in the mid–14 century DR.

Giada is a teenaged girl and the youngest angel on New Capenna. At the Cabaretti Crescendo, she was revealed to be The Font, a new source of Halo. She sacrificed herself to save Elspeth Tirel and was revived with Halo during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Gorm and Virtus, known as the Great and the Veiled respectively, are a giant warrior and azra assassin pair from the plane of Kylem.

Hazoret is the Jackal-headed Amonkheti god of zeal. She was responsible for the final trial and slaughtered the winner with her spear, rewarding them with the God-Pharaoh's presence. After the Hour of Devastation she became known as the God-Survivor.
Cuamogh was was one of the leaders of the Batiri Shattered Spear tribe in Samarach circa 1374 DR.
"Icy" was the nickname given by Garruk Wildspeaker to the anonymous ice-wielding planeswalker that confronted him on Shandalar.
Himoto, nicknamed Pompon by her planeswalker companion Kaito Shizuki, is the Kami of the Spark from Kamigawa.
Hylda of the Icy Crown is a powerful witch from Eldraine. She is the sister of Agatha, Eriette, and an unnamed witch who was the birth mother of the Kenrith twins.

A crest of vigilance eternal was a symbol worn on the arms—either as bracers or a shield—that helped the wearer to focus in combat. This magic was said to be fueled by the eternal courage of the Devas.
Sidar Jabari is one of the most powerful members of the Zhalfirin royal army.

Jared Carthalion, also known as the Shadow Mage, is a member of the long and illustrious Carthalion lineage, dating back far into the Ice Age. He is a planeswalker from Dominaria with the powers of a Ley Druid and an Elder Druid.

Jacques le Vert was a legendary human warrior who lived in ancient times on Dominaria, before the Brothers' War. He abandoned his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, his homeland, and devoted all of his life to protecting its creatures. His legendary battle against The Brute in front of the tree city was represented on mosaics from the College of Lat-Nam. He was the first to bear the ancient Sword of the Meek, which has the ability to return from the graveyard. Even if after the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria the lush greenery of Pendelhaven has withered, the Pendelhaven Elder still carries the ancestral mantle of Jacques and continues his mission: to protect the creatures of his homeland.
Crested helmets were an open-faced style of helmet found in the Realms.
Syr Imodane is a Human woman and pyromancer from Eldraine. She briefly declared herself Queen.
Isobel was an angel of Innistrad who was a part of The Flight of Alabaster led by Bruna.

Ilona is an Orzhov potentate and kingpin, leader of one of the Syndicate's cartels. She has a winged pet thrull named Lord Kazmyr, and has hired the executioner Bilagru to claim the lives of debtors who cannot pay their debts in servitude.

Crochet was a style of craft in which clothing and other goods were fashioned out of yarn with the use of a crochet hook and similar implements. The term could also apply to the products or patterns created through the art of crochet.

Jehadt was the warder of Gordahn, a proud keraunomancer who prepared for the right to stand for the village in the wizards' duel of Mirrankkar. However, on the day before the duel, the planeswalkers Mezlok and Taishiar walked into the village, and the village's leader announced that Mezlok would be the village's champion. Outraged, Jehadt challenged Mezlok for the right to represent the village, but Mezlok defeated him easily, despite Jehadt's Circle of Protection: Red. He was the great-grandson of Minoch.

Jorgan Hage was an Aerathi berserker from Dominaria. He served in the Kentsu, first as the second in command, later as general. Hage was infuriated when Ramses Overdark remarked that the Kentsu had fallen deeply to let barbarians like the Ærathi in its ranks. He ambushed him, but the assassin proved too powerful. Overdark infused Hage with black mana, making the berserker his minion, but erased all knowledge of their encounter from Hage's mind. For a while Overdark let Hage continue as normal, fighting as Marhault Elsdragon's second in command, but when Elsdragon had no further purpose in Overdark's plans, he had Hage decapitate the general and claim the title. Thus Overdark had replaced a general loyal to the emperor with a general loyal to himself. Hage quickly promoted his own tribesmen to commanders and marshals, but after a gigantic defeat on Argenti he was called back to defend the Imperial Shrine in which Overdark was stationed. When Tetsuo Umezawa showed up, declaring he wanted vengeance on Overdark, Jorgan had his army attack the lone warrior, but Tetsuo called down a meteor shower that killed everyone but the black-mana infused Hage and himself. Hage and Tetsuo fought, a battle in which Tetsuo was victorious. Later Tetsuo used Hage's warhammer in his Meteor Hammer spell.
Kazuul is an ogre slave-master living on the Murasa continent of Zendikar.
The dagger of chaos was a magic blade carrying a strange curse that transformed the wielder into many different forms and sometimes itself.

Kaya Cassir, a.k.a. the Ghost-Assassin, is a human planeswalker from Tolvada with a growing reputation as an accomplished ghost hunter. She was the nominal guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica between 4560 and 4562 AR. For an undisclosed reason, she cannot use her family name. On Kaldheim, she was called Kaya Far-Traveler and Slayer of the Bloodsky Sire.
Kaima, the Kami of Forest Fellowship, is a Kami from the plane of Kamigawa, who has the form of a massive boar with bear's claws.
Junji is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. He is the reincarnation of Kokusho.
Daggers were short, two-sided blades used for stabbing and thrusting. They were not as long as a short sword, but were larger than a common knife.

Korlash is a legendary zombie warrior from Dominaria's past. Very little is known about Korlash. He is possibly a descendant of Dakkon Blackblade, though he could just as easily be the heir to the actual Blackblade itself. What it is sure of, however, is that he was one of the champions of darkness - like Dakkon and Sol'Kanar - to have wielded the Blackblade, before the legendary sword was recovered by the Cabal and passed into the possession of the demon Belzenlok.
Lathliss, Dragon Queen, is a legendary dragon from an unknown plane.
Kroxa is the titan of Death's Hunger, on the plane of Theros.

Dabron Sashenstar was a merchant prince of Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast in the mid–14 century DR. He was an aristocrat and leader of House Sashenstar and he also owned and led the Merchant's League based in the city. He was a renowned explorer, who journeyed across the Great Glacier and mapped a trade route to the fabled realm of Sossal.
Kuhnde is a former mantis rider, and a prospective phoenix rider of the Jeskai Clan in the original timeline of Tarkir. It is unknown if he exists in Tarkir's new timeline.

Mangara of Corondor was a human mage on Dominaria known for his peaceful nature and diplomatic skills. He was protected by Eskil the White. Mangara's lifetime was longer than a normal human's, likely due to his magic, and he was already centuries old by the time the Mirage War started.
Malfegor was a rare hybrid beast, a dragon with a demonic soul, from the shard of Alara known as Grixis.
Dakath was a half-elf fighter from Nesmé. He died around 1264 DR while wearing the Shield Belt of Storms, which led to the belt being taken to Zelphar Arunsun in Blackstaff Tower.
Medomai (MEH-doh-migh), the Wandering Oracle is a male sphinx and a seer from Theros.
Mezlok was a proud young human planeswalker and keraunomancer. He was the great-grandson of Minoch.

Nevar was a powerful wizard on an unknown plane, and archenemy to the wizard Jamil. He was destroyed by Caliphear the Nightmare when she was summoned by Jamil after his war against Nevar had come to a standstill.
Daeghun Farlong was a male elven inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Svogthir, called the "god-zombie," was the parun of the Golgari Swarm on the plane of Ravnica.

Talrand is a Merfolk wizard who rules beneath the waves of the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar. He challenged the dominion of the dragon Kalyntri above the sea. The mage seems equally comfortable on the ground as in the seas, wields a large assortment of blue spells, and has the power to summon drake servants. They serve him in exchange for his promise of an end to the tyranny of dragons. In a concerted effort, Talrand and a large flock of Drakes killed Kalyntri.
Tanazir Quandrix is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven. The Quandrix College is named in her honor. She is a master of the magics that govern reality and abstraction.
The Cutlass of the Golden Gulf was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara, the Land of Fate. It was favored by corsairs and other sailors.
Thabit of Almaaz was a Dominarian human song-mage from Almaaz who organized the Uprising in Epityr, a successful rebellion against the Sheoltuns.

Tovolar is a powerful werewolf on the plane of Innistrad and the main antagonist of the Innistrad: Midnight Hunt storyline. He was the alpha werewolf of the Mondronen howlpack before their disbandment and later became the leader of the Dire pack.

Thraximundar is a brutal undead warrior from Alaran Grixis who lives to slay. He is fully seven feet tall and rippling with dead muscle, clad in dreadful spiked armor and wielding a greatsword. Astride his massive dreg reaver mount like some dark parody of a knight, Thraximundar - whose name means "he who paints the earth red" - is drawn to the sounds and emotions of mass violence. He never takes sides - he slays anyone, taking grim pleasure in the pure act of war itself.
The dagger of fiery demise was a wicked magic weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame.

Thrissik is one of the the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia. Thrissik believes that Phyrexia must give birth to its destroyer. The destroyer will destroy Phyrexia, so it can be reborn. The cycle must continue because Phyrexia must always be improved and strengthened. With each resurrection from its own ashes, Phyrexia will be stronger than before. Thrissik seeks the Destroyer and wants to place himself as the Father of Machines. After Roxith came to its realm to harvest flesh, Thrissik attacked the Thane in order to determine if he was the "destroyer". Thrissik managed to substantially injure Roxith and concluded he was not the "destroyer".

The Wanderer is a former planeswalker introduced in War of the Spark. She is the current Emperor of Kamigawa, and one of the most efficient and deadly warriors seen on any plane. She lost her spark during the Desparkening, but unlike her fellow planeswalkers, this was a great benefit to her.
Toggo is a goblin artificer from Dominaria and the self-proclaimed inventor of and lightning.
A dagger of venom was a common magic blade with the power to poison.

The Traveler, also known in Tazeem as the Outsider, in Tolaria as the Visitor, in Gavony as the Butcher of Crussebourg, and in Shiv as the Hero of Old Onkoom, is the moniker for the player-created human planeswalker that was introduced in the Magic: Legends computer game. The cause for the Traveler's spark is currently unknown, and their name, gender, and appearance, as well as their power set, are determined by the player. Non-player characters style the planeswalker as the "Traveler" throughout the game except in Tazeem, where the inhabitants address the person as the "Outsider".
Tivit, the Seller of Secrets, is a Sphinx rogue from Capenna. They are a seer for the Obscura.

Transmogrants were artifact zombies created by Ashnod during the Brothers' War on Dominaria. They were eyeless attack units created from the bodies of those who died in combat, of sickness, or refused to serve. Though mass-produced, each one seemed to have a unique body, a one-off marriage of dead flesh and iron. The soulless transmogrants had dead and graying skin, stretched and woven through dark metal. They walked without outward care of the cold. They carried no weapons, but wicked claws burst from weeping stumps. Bloodless flaps with dead tufts of hair pulled taught over polished metal domes. Chain veils hid the ruins of faces. A living specimen, too grotesque and unpredictable to display, was preserved beneath the museum at the College of Lat-Nam.

Cutter #1: Birthright is the first issue in a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos'un and Doum'wielle Armgo and the sentient sword Khazid'hea; it takes place just prior to Night of the Hunter. The story was written by R.A. Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore. The majority of the art was done by David Baldeon, with David Garcia Cruz (colors) and Neil Uyetake (letters). Steve Ellis contributed cover art.
Turg was a massive anurid frog beast employed by Ambassador Laquatus on Dominaria.
Urgoros is a specter from Vhelnish on Dominaria, who serves Belzenlok.
Veyran, Voice of Duality is an efreet wizard teacher at the Prismari College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

Cutter #2: The Lost Child is the second issue in a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos'un and Doum'wielle Armgo and the sentient sword Khazid'hea; it takes place just prior to Night of the Hunter. The story was written by R.A. Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore. The majority of the art was done by David Baldeon, with David Garcia Cruz (colors) and Neil Uyetake (letters). Steve Ellis contributed cover art.

Zirilan of the Claw was an old viashino warlord from the Great Desert on Jamuraa (Dominaria). He was an ally of Jolrael and Hivis of the Scale. While Hivis bent the dragons of Jamuraa to his will, Zirilan forged a pact with the dragons, brokering peace between their tribes. Once he had established a sacred martial treaty, Zirilan could lead them into battle. He was a very ingenious commander, knowing how best to exploit the mighty strength at his command. He joined the side of Jolrael and Kaervek in the Mirage War, but after Jolrael defected he retreated into the Great Desert. The treaty established by Zirilan has held for centuries, with Jamuraa's current Claw being Rivaz.

Yidaro is a huge and deadly Dinosaur Turtle from Ikoria. He is capable of incredible damage, but also kind of sweetly inattentive. The monster is easily distracted — his attention tends to wander. But if he ever focuses his attention on something, he will obliterate it.
Aerophin (sometimes referred to as aerophuis) were artificial creatures created as servants of the Vedalken of Lumengrid prior to the plane becoming New Phyrexia.

Cutter #3: Sword, Wielder is the third issue in a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos'un and Doum'wielle Armgo and the sentient sword Khazid'hea; it takes place just prior to Night of the Hunter. The story was written by R.A. Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore. The majority of the art was done by David Baldeon, with David Garcia Cruz (colors) and Neil Uyetake (letters). Steve Ellis contributed cover art.

Betor is the Mythic Spirit Dragon of the Abzan Houses on Tarkir. They came into being after Narset performed the Stormnexus Ritual and Felothar called them forth. When Betor was summoned, the lost and drifting spirits of the Abzan coalesced into their being. With these spirits, Betor became a manifestation of the Abzan's past, their present, and their desire for independence and reconnection to their history.
Dee Kay is a legendary zombie employee who works at the Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun in the Un-iverse.

The Grand Calcutron, born Calvin Granderson, is the founder and leader of the Order of the Widget in Bablovia. Having replaced most of his body with machinery, Grand Calcutron is no longer considered human.

Cutter #4: A Dark Path is the fourth issue in a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos'un and Doum'wielle Armgo and the sentient sword Khazid'hea; it takes place just prior to Night of the Hunter. The story was written by R.A. Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore. The majority of the art was done by David Baldeon, with David Garcia Cruz (colors) and Neil Uyetake (letters). Steve Ellis contributed cover art.

Murgaxor Grenshel is a notorious former student of Strixhaven University, expelled from Witherbloom College for the lethal use of life-draining magic. Once believed dead, he later re-emerged, prolonging his life through dark and forbidden arts, and orchestrating a plot to drain the vitality of the university’s population to achieve true immortality.
Nohr was a weatherworker on Cridhe responsible for the Parting.

Neriv is the Mythic Spirit Dragon of the Mardu Horde on Tarkir, and the living banner around which they rally. He came into being after Narset performed the Stormnexus Ritual and Zurgo called him forth.

Cutter #5: Homecoming is the fifth and final issue in a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos'un and Doum'wielle Armgo and the sentient sword Khazid'hea; it takes place just prior to Night of the Hunter. The story was written by R.A. Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore. The majority of the art was done by David Baldeon, with David Garcia Cruz (colors) and Neil Uyetake (letters). Steve Ellis contributed cover art.
Ormacar, Relic Wraith, is an elf wraith from an unknown plane.
Shabraz is a monstrous Shark Bird from Ikoria. Brallin is its bonder.
Tsagan, Raider Warlord, is a legendary Saurid Berserker from Muraganda.
Daeros's full plate was a dwarven-crafted suit of full plate armor worn by Daeros Dragonspear, builder of Dragonspear Castle.
Zul Ashur is a zombie warlock and a powerful lich tyrant from an unknown plane.

Agatha Harkness is a Marvel Comics character who appears in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, as the main antagonist of the Marvel Disney+ series WandaVision and the titular protagonist/anti-heroine of Agatha All Along. She is a powerful witch from Salem, Massachusetts. Centuries after the Salem witch trials and losing her son, Agatha sensed Wanda Maximoff creating a hex where she could live a fantasy life by bringing back Vision and two sons Billy and Tommy Maximoff. Agatha was able to intervine and enter the sitcom world, posing as "Agnes O'Connor, Wanda and Vision's nosy neighbor. However, Agatha later revealed herself to Wanda and fought her in the battle of Westview, as well as being the one who informed Wanda of her capabilities and potential as the Scarlet Witch, while in possession of the legendary Darkhold. Although Agatha was eventually defeated by Wanda, who placed the ancient witch under a spell for three years. While living under Wanda's spell, Agatha continued her fake life as Agnes O'Connor, where she believed she was a detective covering a Jane Doe murder case, before being released from the spell in 2026, by a reincarnated, resurrected, Billy Maximoff, whom Agatha couldn't identify because of a sigil placed on him. Together, they conjured the legendary Witches' Road, along with a few other Witches. However, desperate to get her magic back, Agatha planned to use the road to receive her powers and steal some from the other witches, which eventually led to some of

Aftershock is a Marvel Comics character that appears in the Disney Channel series Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur. She is a supervillainess with the power to control electricity. Aftershock was created by Sean McKeever and Casey Jones.
A daikyu () was a type of composite longbow. It was the largest variety of bow in use in Kara-Tur, but was rarely seen outside of that continent.

Aetos is a minor character that appears in the Hercules TV series. He is a giant bird who was ordered by Zeus to eat the liver of the imprisoned Titan Prometheus every day as punishment for the Titan's disobedience.
Algrim the Strong is the secondary antagonist of Thor: The Dark World and was one of the Dark Elves of Svartalfheim who became Kurse, an enemy of Thor. Algrim was created by Walt Simonson.

Alioth is a character from Marvel Comics that appears in the Disney+ series Loki. Alioth is living tempest that consumes everything that is sent to the Void at the end of time after being pruned by the Time Variance Authority. It also guards the entrance of the Citadel at the End of Time, which is the home of the creator of the organization, He Who Remains. Alioth was created by Mark Gruenwald and Mike Gustovich.
A dagger of life stealing was a a vicious enchanted weapon that stole the life essence of from rended flesh.

Alisa Jones (née Campbell) is a Marvel Comics character featured in the Marvel Television series Jessica Jones. She is the mother of Jessica Jones and serves as the primary antagonist of the second season. Long presumed dead following the car accident that killed her husband and son, Alisa was actually saved by the organization IGH and transformed into a powerful, albeit unstable, superhuman. Alisa Jones is based on Mrs. Campbell, who was created by Brian Michael Bendis and Michael Gaydos.
Amuk Moonrah is a villain in the Aladdin TV series. He is an ancient, powerful, and demonic being that ruled Agrabah thousands of years ago before he was sealed away in the mountains.

America Chavez is a Marvel Comics character who appears in the Marvel Cinematic Universe film Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. She also appears in the Marvel Rising: Secret Warriors animated film. America Chavez was created by Joe Casey and Nick Dragotta.
The Daggerford Blade was an enchanted halberd wielded by Nayeli Goldflower, a former member of the Guardians of Daggerford, in the late 15 century DR.

The Archmage was a powerful-but-arrogant-and-greedy magician from Disney's Gargoyles. He taught both the Magus and Demona how to use magic, having once been a courtier at Castle Wyvern and he was the first person known to possess the spellbook called the Grimorum Arcanorum.

Arnim Zola is a supervillain from Marvel Comics, specifically for Captain America. He is the secondary antagonist of the 2011 live-action film Captain America: The First Avenger and a minor antagonist in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He is a Nazi scientist from Switzerland who has survived to the current day by experimenting on himself. Arnim Zola was created by Jack Kirby.
Awesome Android is a brick-headed android. Awesome Android was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

Daern Claundon, also known as Orcbane, was a dwarven adventurer from the Sword Coast North who had risen to fame in the Heartlands as of the mid-to-late 14 century DR for his hatred of orcs and his tireless pursuit of killing them.

B.R.A.W.N. (short for Bounty Robotic Assault Weapons Negotiator) a large golden robotic peacekeeper who also doubles as a bounty hunter/gaoler of the limbo prison. Serving as jailers whom guarded the incarcerated saurian race, this one had been sent to capture and retrieve Dragaunus a.k.a prisoner 476 on Earth. But was reprogrammed by the latter to eliminate the Ducks instead. Tanya was able to re-reprogram him into joining their cause and stopping Dragaunus' assault platform. Almost his entire body was destroyed, but his head still remained. He briefly appears in "The Return of Asteroth".

Balthazar Blake is one of the two main protagonists in Disney's The Sorcerer's Apprentice. He was a student of Merlin and a sorcerer. More than 1,000 years old, Balthazar has been searching the globe until he finds the Prime Merlinean, the descendant of Merlin and inheritor of his great magic powers. When Balthazar finally discovers him in 10-year-old Dave Stutler, he finds himself with a very reluctant sorcerer’s apprentice.
Bellepheron was a Greek hero-king of Corinth from the Hercules episode "Hercules and the Pegasus Incident".
Dak'kon's Zerth blade was a unique katana that belonged to the famous githzerai named Dak'kon from the planar city of Sigil.
Big Jet is the main antagonist of the Little Einsteins, acting as the former rival and arch-nemesis of the titular team.

The Caucasian Eagle is a minor character that appears in the Hercules TV series. He is a giant bird who was ordered by Zeus to eat the liver of the imprisoned Titan Prometheus every day as punishment for the Titan's disobedience.

Chester is a character form Halloweentown High. He's a giant with a bit of forest ogre from his mom's side and one of the transfer students. He dislikes wrestling, likes stamps and has a pet armadillo. Despite his size, he is rather kind.
Gauntlet Dain was a solider of the Flaming Fist of that served during the late 15 century DR.

Chloe Wang, better known professionally as Chloe Bennet, is an American actress and singer, who, for Disney, portrayed Daisy Johnson aka Skye/Quake in the ABC/Marvel television series Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. and voiced her in Marvel Rising: Secret Warriors. She also played Hailey in 7 episodes of Nashville and voiced Swifty in Jake and the Never Land Pirates and Chase in Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast, and Lucy Chen in the Disney+ film Jonas Brothers Christmas Movie. For FX, she played Robyn in Dave, and for Hulu, she played Detective Lana Lee in Interior Chinatown. Outside of Disney, Bennet voiced Yi in the 2019 DreamWorks/Pearl Studio animated film Abominable.
Clementine the Spider is a character who appears in Legend of the Three Caballeros. She is a giant spider that lives in the Nazca Realm.

Sprungston Waddlespin III, better known by his supervillain name Chronoduck, is a villain featured in the Darkwing Duck comic books published by Boom! Studios and Joe Books. He debuted in the story "The Untimely Terror of the Time Turtle", written by Darkwing creator Tad Stones and originally published in Boom!'s Darkwing Duck Annual #1.
Dak'kon was a githzerai fighter and mage who, following a crisis of faith, ended up becoming a servant of the Nameless One.

Coldstone, occasionally referred to as "Othello", is a character from the Disney animated series Gargoyles. He was a Gargoyle member of the Wyvern Clan who, long after being shattered by the Vikings, was rebuilt as an android (or cyborg) along with the fragments of two other clan members.
Commander Peepers is Lord Hater's number one henchman, leader of the watchdogs, and a major antagonist of the show Wander Over Yonder.

The Cold Monster is a character in Future-Worm! He is a monster created from Danny's cold, which soon became malevolent and caused havoc and pain at Sci-Fi-Fanti-Con, until it was defeated by Danny's father.
A cursed berserking sword was a sword that bore a curse that sent its wielder into a bloodthirsty frenzy during the heat of battle.
Clown is the a Marvel Comics character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, appearing in Ironheart. She is a member of the Hood's gang, being an expert in explosives and pyrotechnics.

Coyote is a a succession of antagonistic robots, designed by David Xanatos and the Scarab Corporation, mainly for the purposes of leading the Pack. So far, five different models have been built and at least three more will be constructed in the future. He is featured in the Disney animated television show Gargoyles.

The Crocodile is a character who appears in the the 2023 live-action film Peter Pan & Wendy, where he is portrayed as a giant crocodile, brownish in color thus resembling a Sarcosuchus. He is based on both the crocodile from the play by J.M. Barrie and Tick-Tock from Disney's 1953 animated film Peter Pan.
Dagohnlar was a noble house of Cormyr, based in Marsember, in the late 14 century DR. They had a suit of ancestral armor.

Crazy Harry is a humanoid Muppet who loves to cause explosions and is an expert on pyrotechnics. He was originally called Crazy Donald, a reference to Muppet builder Don Sahlin, who created some of the Muppets' special effects, including explosions.

Dagger (real name Tandy Bowen) is a Marvel Comics character and one of the protagonists of the Narvek Freeform series Cloak & Dagger. She is a young superhero, with the ability to control light. Dagger were created by Bill Mantlo and Ed Hannigan.

Darren Cross (formerly known as Yellowjacket and later known as M.O.D.O.K.) is the CEO of Cross Technological Enterprises, and the main antagonist in the 2015 Marvel Studios film Ant-Man. He is portrayed by Corey Stoll. Darren Cross was created by David Michelinie and John Byrne. Yellowjacket was created by Roy Thomas and John Buscema. M.O.D.O.K. was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Dantrag Baenre was a drow fighter, and the weapons master of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan.
Dim Long (点长 Diǎn zhǎng) is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba, and the fourth experiment he created in China based on what he learns in ancient Chinese scrolls.

Doctor Doom is a supervillain from Marvel Comics, serving as the main antagonist of the Marvel film Avengers: Doomsday. He made his debut in a cameo appearance in the post-credits of the 2025 film The Fantastic Four: First Steps. He is the King of Latveria and the archenemy of the Fantastic Four. Doctor Doom was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

Don Karnage is the main antagonist of Disney's animated television series TaleSpin. He is the leader of a band of Air Pirates that are constantly trying to get over the border of Cape Suzette to plunder it, but his plans are often foiled by a bear cargo pilot named Baloo and the employees of the single airplane cargo delivery company he works for, Higher for Hire.

Darksteel was a very hard alloy of star metal created by the dwarves of Clan Ironstar that could be used to forge weapons and armor of special properties and powers. It was also known as dunchalcor, dark steel and ironstar steel.

Dominus Tusk is a giant minotaur who served as a frequent, albeit usually minor, threat and was often quickly disposed of by Aladdin and his friends. He appeared in the Aladdin episodes "A Clockwork Hero", "Armored and Dangerous" and "While the City Snoozes".
Dr. Rosenthal was the former head scientist of the Anti-Recess Legion in charge of manning the Weather-Altering Laser.
Druig is a Marvel Comics character who appears in Eternals, played by Barry Keoghan. Druig was created by Jack Kirby.
Lord Dalren was a noble of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Elizabeth Chase Olsen is an American actress and singer, who is best known for her film roles, such as the titular character of , Sarah in the 2011 psychological horror film , Elizabeth "Zibby" in the 2012 comedy-drama film , and Elle Brodyin the 2014 sci-fi monster film . For Disney, she portrayed Wanda Maximoff/Scarlet Witch in the Marvel Cinematic Universe films: Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Avengers: Age of Ultron, Captain America: Civil War, Avengers: Infinity War, Avengers: Endgame, and Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, as well as the TV series WandaVision and What If...? She is also the younger sister of twin actresses and fashion designers Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

Eric Martin Andrew Banadinović, known professionally as Eric Bana, AM, is an Australian actor, voice actor, comedian, producer, and screenwriter, who is best known for his roles in Chopper, Black Hawk Down, Hulk as Bruce Banner/Hulk, Troy, Munich, and Star Trek. For Disney, he voiced Anchor in the 2003 Disney/Pixar film Finding Nemo and played Daniel Cluff in Disney's 2016 live-action thriller film The Finest Hours. He also voiced Monterey Jack in the 2022 Disney+ original film Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers.

Emperor Belos is the main antagonist of the Disney Channel animated series The Owl House. He was the ruler of the Boiling Isles, and founder of the Coven system. He is later revealed to be Philip Wittebane, a 17th century witch hunter from Gravesfield, Connecticut during the Deadwardian Era (Which would be the mid 1600s in the human realm/world), who is hellbent on killing all of the witches on the Isles and all life in the Human Realm as his ultimate omnicide goal.
Sir Darmon was a male human and member of the Nine of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Ezra Bridger is the protagonist of the Disney XD animated series Star Wars Rebels and a recurring character in the live-action Disney+ series Star Wars: Ahsoka. Once a common orphan trying to survive, Ezra is eventually adopted by Kanan Jarrus, who acknowledges his Force potential and joins the crew of the Ghost in their small Rebellion against the Empire.

Evanora Harkness is a character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe featured in the Marvel Disney+ series WandaVision and Agatha All Along, first appearing in the eighth episode of WandaVision. She is portrayed by Kate Forbes. Evanora is the mother of Agatha Harkness, and was a powerful witch. She was killed by her daughter, after Agatha was found guilty of betraying their coven. She later returned as a ghost, and appeared before her daughter, after Agatha and her coven walked the Witches' Road.
Ezekiel Jeremiah Whiffleboard "Tug The Tornado" Tugbottom is the main antagonist of The Ghost and Molly McGee episode "Monumental Disaster", and a minor character throughout the rest of the series.

Darhost "the Mongrel" Tharsuir was a Tashalan human fighter and, circa 1373 DR, the hereditary ruling Shoonsar of Ithmong, a city holy to Bhaelros, in Lapaliiya. Ithmong was the second-most-powerful city of the Lapal League. In practice, the Overking of Lapaliiya needed to negotiate with Shoonsar Darhost to have decrees passed by the Grand Council.

Eva Madden is one of the main protagonists of the Disney Channel original series The Villains of Valley View. She is a retired supervillain from Centropolis formerly known by her supervillain name, Surge. She and Vic moved their family to Valley View, Texas after going on the run, in order to raise the kids and live a normal life. She is portrayed Lucy Davis.

Evan Thomas Peters is an American actor. He has appeared in movies such as , , , , , and . For television, he has appeared in , , , , , , and , where he portrayed the titular character. For Disney, he portrayed Seth Wosmer in Phil of the Future. He also played Peter Maximoff/Quicksilver in the films , , , and Dark Phoenix. He portrayed Ralph Bohner in the Marvel Cinematic Universe Disney+ series WandaVision and Agatha All Along. Additionally, he voiced Simon in Wish and played Julian Dillinger in Tron: Ares. Additionally, he appeared in the horror series , where he portrayed various characters throughout the seasons, and played Stan Bowes in the drama series .

Fariha is a character who appears within the Marvel Cinematic Universe. She made her debut in the third episode of the Disney+ series Ms. Marvel and is portrayed by starring cast member Adaku Ononogbo. Fariha is a member of the Clandestines. She is a Djinn, originating from the Noor Dimension, who was exiled to Earth, and has been searching a way to return home, ever since. She and the other members of the group seek out Kamala Khan, who possesses a bangle, which serves as an instrumental key in their return home.
Danthelon's Dancing Axe was a general store located on Wyrm's Crossing in Baldur's Gate. It sold good quality secondhand wares, from pots and pans to rope, armor, and weapons.

The Gilded Man is a character who was first featured in Donald Duck comic, [https://inducks.org/story.php?c=W+OS++422-00 Donald Duck and the Gilded Man], first published on July 15, 1952. He is a giant man from the lost city of El Dorado that covered himself in gold serving as the city's guardian.
Goliath is the protagonist of Disney's animated television series Gargoyles. He is the leader of the Manhattan Clan and a survivor of the Wyvern Clan.
Original= Groot is a Marvel Comics character who is a member of the Guardians of the Galaxy. He is a Flora Colossus from Planet X. Groot was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby and Larry Lieber.

Dangwaru (Typhoon Palace) was a palace built on the Snout of Omgar by the tortles to make the crew of a wrecked ship feel at home in the late 14 century DR. By the late 15 century DR, the palace was dilapidated and haunted. Young tortles went to the palace to find treasure but were quickly scared away. The captain of the ship was a human female whom the tortles admired. She worshiped Umberlee and told the tortles stories of sea monsters that she'd fought. She supposedly died about fifty years after her arrival but was in fact transformed into a carrion crawler by Umberlee for an unknown slight.
